name: Skillsync
long_description: Skillsync gives you one place for everything your agents have ever done, and makes all of it portable. Move a full session between Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and any other agent with nothing lost, including the entire conversation, the model's reasoning, and every tool call, not just a summary, so the next agent picks up like it was there the whole time. Because your sessions are portable, they stack up instead of disappearing. Every past session stays searchable and feeds your next agent automatically, so you never re-explain yourself or redo work you have already done. Everything stays on your machine and nothing leaves unless you choose to send it. Skillsync is local-first and yours, and its core engine, txcript, is open source, a portable session format that no single provider owns.

launches.title: Skillsync: Move your context across every coding agent
launches.tagline: Meet Skillsync, your context made portable across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and every agent you use.
launches.body:
👋 We're Nars and Nishant, founders of Skillsync (W26).

**TL;DR:** Skillsync lets you move your context (sessions, memory, and skills) across every coding agent you use, with nothing lost. Start in Claude Code, continue in Codex, sync it with your team. Say it once; every agent & teammate has it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112177&key=user_uploads/2980881/daf33474-9f03-4b30-ae87-d2d5de4efb88)

AI chats are annoying. Your context is trapped inside whatever agent you're using. You plan everything out in the Claude app, then open Claude Code to build, and none of that thinking comes with you. Switch from Claude Code to Cursor or Codex and it's the same story: you start from zero, re-explaining everything. And sharing your best skills with your team means zip files and Slack messages nobody can find.

Skillsync is a **local-first desktop app** that frees your context from any single agent:

* 🔁 **Move a session between agents with nothing lost**, including the full conversation, reasoning, and tool history.
* 🧠 **KYC: Know Your Context.** Keep your skills and memory in one place, searchable from any agent via MCP.
* 👥 **Sync your skills across your team**, edit once and everyone stays current. No zip files, no stale copies.

Everything runs on your machine, so your context stays yours.

We spent years building open source payments infra that connected dozens of payment processors, and scaled it to 30k+ GitHub stars. Making all those systems talk to each other taught us what real interoperability takes.

**One more thing…** 

The hard part, the engine that translates sessions across different agent formats without losing anything, is **open source**. It's written in Rust and it's called **txcript:** <https://github.com/skillsynchq/txcript/>. Don't take our word for it: **read the code**.

We're on a mission to set your context free. If this resonates, try Skillsync at <https://skillsync.com>

You can also reach us at [founders@skillsync.com](mailto:founders@skillsync.com)
